selectivity_of_abstention.reading: the verbalizer never produced a correct answer, so nothing in these artifacts can be read as arm C knowing an answer when it speaks. What can be read is the gate: whether it lets through taught asks more often than never-taught ones, and the Youden J of each threshold.
selectivity_of_abstention.why_this_is_measured: clause 2 as registered compares refusal on never-taught rows only, and arm C's correct rate is 0 at every tier, so a high never-taught refusal is compatible with blanket refusal. AMD-MPE8-12 makes the gate measures the hypothesis-bearing quantity, and a calibration claim without a discrimination measure is not a calibration claim.
